create_PoseTW_from_Rt: create a PoseTW object from a rotation matrix and translation vector using PoseTW.from_Rt
compose_PoseTW_transforms: compose two SE3 poses together using PoseTW.compose or the matmul operator to chain transforms
interpolate_PoseTW_poses: interpolate poses at arbitrary timestamps using PoseTW.interpolate with times and interp_times tensors
align_PoseTW_trajectories: align two PoseTW trajectories using Horn method via PoseTW.align to compute relative SE3 transform
transform_points_with_PoseTW: transform 3D points using PoseTW.transform or the multiply operator to apply SE3 pose to point clouds
